node.title: Re^2: Not a HASH reference
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
$in is not being opened.

That seems to be very unlikely. Based on dir(...), ->children and ->openr, I am guessing this is [mod://Path::Class]. Its openr throws an error if the file couldn't be opened. Even if $in were undef, there would need to be a file named tocsvfd.xml in the same path as the script, otherwise XMLin would throw an error.
